content_data.project_title: European AI-Driven Travel Personalization Engine Expansion
content_data.project_description: Proposal to scale our AI-powered travel recommendation engine across key European markets, enhancing user engagement and optimizing booking conversion rates.
content_data.timeline: 18 months, with initial market penetration during the first 6 months and full regional rollout by the end of the project.
content_data.project_lead: Lena Petrova, Head of European Sales
objectives: Improve customer lifetime value (CLV) by 15% through personalized recommendations.
Establish key strategic partnerships with local travel operators.
Expand market share in at least three new European countries.
deliverables: Detailed market entry strategies for new European regions.
Comprehensive sales training modules for regional teams.
Monthly performance reports and quarterly strategic reviews.
Partnership agreements with 5+ key regional travel providers.
Localized AI recommendation models for each target market.
success_metrics: New customer acquisition rate in target regions.
Regional sales team performance against targets.
content_data.sales_strategy: Our strategy involves a multi-pronged approach: direct sales to B2B travel partners, targeted digital marketing campaigns in new regions, and leveraging existing customer data to cross-sell and upsell personalized travel packages. Focus on demonstrating ROI to partners and fostering strong, long-term relationships.
